"tables can have row security policies that restrict, on a per-user basis, which rows can be returned by normal queries"; "Superusers and roles with the BYPASSRLS attribute always bypass the row security system when accessing a table. Table owners normally bypass row security as well" (WebFetch summary, quoted).

LEFT OUTER JOIN: "for each row in T1 that does not satisfy the join condition with any row in T2, a joined row is added with null values in columns of T2. Thus, the joined table always has at least one row for each row in T1." The joins chain from `customers`, so every customer stays.

max_connections: "Determines the maximum number of concurrent connections to the database server. The default is typically 100 connections". The lesson says only "a limited number of connections at once" and gives no number.
orders-by-day.sql lines 11-12: "The two orders that fall on different days are the ones placed in the early morning Vietnam time, which is still the previous day in UTC." (round 1)
